CustomField.description: Drives the Create Booking button. Other projects: always true. The Legacey: the unit must have Company Share and Landowner Share (Share__c), and when its LL Share Name is a landowner (not BUILDER) it must also have AGPA Number and AGPA Date.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( Project1__r.Name = "The Legacey", Unit__r.Project__r.Name = "The Legacey" ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Unit__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Unit__r.Share__c, "")), OR( ISPICKVAL(Unit__r.LL_Share_Name__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Unit__r.LL_Share_Name__c, "BUILDER"), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Unit__r.AGPA_Number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Unit__r.AGPA_Date__c)) ) ) ), TRUE )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when a booking can be created from this quote. For The Legacey the unit needs Company Share and Landowner Share, plus AGPA Number and AGPA Date when the LL Share Name is not BUILDER.
CustomField.label: Show Create Booking
